ZX0 Python port by Teppo Koskinen (https://github.com/orlof/zx0, BSD-3-Clause) of the compressor by Einar Saukas (https://github.com/einar-saukas/ZX0). dzx0_standard.asm: Einar Saukas & Urusergi.

LOCAL PATCH (see zx0_common.py): inversion of the Elias-Gamma data bits only for the offset MSB and the end marker, as in the reference C compressor.
